<translate>
'''Frieza''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who waits at [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Ship|Frieza's Ship]] on the Ajissa Plains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Namek]]. He teaches a wide range of skills and his own ki attacks, but only to Evil-aligned players.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location ==
</translate>
<translate>
Frieza waits at [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Ship|Frieza's Ship]], which generates once per world in the Ajissa Plains of Namek. The Capsule Corp Namekian sells a map to it (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Ship#Finding it|Frieza's Ship]]). You reach Namek by [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Alignment ==
</translate>
<translate>
Frieza needs an [[Special:MyLanguage/Alignment|alignment]] of '''40 or lower''' (Evil). Above that he still talks to you, but his '''Skills''', '''Train''' and new quests stay locked.
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques ==
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Fly|Fly]], Jump, Sprint, [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Sense|Ki Sense]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Meditation|Meditation]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Potential Unlock|Potential Unlock]]
* '''Ki attacks:''' Death Beam, [[Special:MyLanguage/Emperor's Death Beam|Emperor's Death Beam]], Supernova, Double Kienzan
* '''Strike attacks:''' Deadly Dance, Meteor
</translate>

<translate>
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill or technique. His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with. Frieza and [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]] cover a huge part of the roster on their own, which is why a Good character can't learn everything from a single master.
</translate>
